# Hey Hon: Raw Jamaican Honey

> Hey Hon is a Jamaican honey producer. Raw, cold extracted, single origin honey from apiaries in the hills of St. Mary, Jamaica. 100% pure, no added sugar.

## Product

- Raw St. Mary Wildflower Honey only, in 266ml and 500ml glass jars.
- 266ml glass jar: JMD $2,200
- 500ml glass jar: JMD $3,200
- Single origin apiaries near Guys Hill and Louisiana in St. Mary.
- RADA/ABIS registration filed July 2026.

## Ordering

- Order on the website (add to bag, checkout on WhatsApp) or directly on WhatsApp: +1 (658) 218-2734, https://wa.me/16582182734
- Delivery day and payment are confirmed on WhatsApp.
- Free custom gift note on every order; corporate gifting and wholesale available on WhatsApp.

## Delivery in Jamaica

- Portmore delivery: JMD $500
- Kingston delivery: JMD $800
- Spanish Town delivery: JMD $800
- Knutsford Express: JMD $700 flat rate to Clarendon, Hanover, Manchester, Portland, St. Ann, St. Elizabeth, St. James, St. Mary, St. Thomas, Trelawny, and Westmoreland
- Free Kingston delivery on orders over JMD $6,000 subtotal
- Free pickup: Sovereign Village, Portmore; Shop 15, Northside Plaza, Kingston 6 (Liguanea, St. Andrew); Digicel Head Office
- Full prices and delivery: https://heyhonjamaica.com/delivery.html

## USA / international

- USA shipping is by WhatsApp quote only. No set USA carrier and no flat USA shipping price yet.
- Honey is generally allowed into the United States in commercial packaging for personal consumption and must be declared to US Customs. Pack honey in checked luggage; liquids over 3.4 oz are not allowed in carry-on luggage. A business sending food to the US must file FDA prior notice.
- To get a USA quote, message Hey Hon on WhatsApp with your US state, quantity, and jar size.
